processes.meter_deal_coverage_fix: Logistics/volume management asks the deal owner to extend, create, or correct a Sitara deal or ticket so that meter flow is covered and allocation exceptions can be cleared.
processes.meter_allocation_payment_dispute: A producer or counterparty chases payment for volumes that were not allocated or paid, requiring volume management to research, reallocate, and have the invoice redrafted.
processes.deal_price_discrepancy_resolution: Settlements or schedulers ask the deal owner to confirm a missing price or mismatched sales/purchase volumes on a deal so it can be corrected and settled.
processes.meter_change_pops_coordination: A multi-step coordinated change to a meter, facility, or flow-data record across volume management, scheduling, settlements and POPS/MOPS, with follow-up verification.
processes.pipeline_contract_termination_review: Contract administration asks the desk to confirm whether deals exist before terminating or amending pipeline contracts in the system.
processes.daily_operations_notice_handling: Recurring operational notices (nominations, actual flows, plant status, capacity cuts, system errors) that logistics staff must read and act on or relay.
